About Us:
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

 Role Description
 LSEG is seeking a Senior Automation Quality Assurance Engineer to join the Quant Analytics Databases team in Bucharest.
In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and integrity of database-driven quantitative analytics products and services. You will design, implement, and maintain automated testing solutions across user interfaces, APIs, data-processing workflows, and databases.
As a senior individual contributor, you will independently own complex testing activities, contribute to the team’s quality strategy, and work closely with software engineers, quantitative specialists, product managers, and other stakeholders across an international environment. You will promote engineering best practices and help the team deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test suites for database-driven applications, APIs, and web interfaces.
Take ownership of test automation activities throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to production release.
Define test approaches for complex features, considering functional correctness, data integrity, regression risk, and system dependencies.
Create and maintain UI automation using Selenium, Playwright, or comparable technologies.
Develop automated tests for REST APIs and other service interfaces, including validation of payloads, error handling, authentication, and integration scenarios.
Perform database testing using SQL to validate data quality, transformations, calculations, consistency, and persistence.
Identify suitable automation opportunities and maintain an effective balance between automated and exploratory testing.
Analyse requirements and technical designs to identify risks, ambiguities, dependencies, and testability concerns early in the delivery process.
Investigate complex failures across application, API, database, and infrastructure layers, clearly communicating findings and supporting root-cause analysis.
Integrate automated tests with version control and continuous integration workflows.
Review test code and contribute to coding standards, reusable components, and maintainable automation practices.
Track and communicate quality risks, test coverage, defects, and release-readiness information to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Use AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve activities such as test design, test-data creation, code generation, failure analysis, and technical documentation, while reviewing generated outputs for accuracy and compliance.
Collaborate proactively with colleagues across different functions, locations, and cultures.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across quality assurance and software engineering practices.
Share knowledge and provide technical guidance through peer reviews, documentation, and day-to-day collaboration, without formal people-management responsibilities.
 Mandatory Skills
Experience: 3–6 years in Software Test Automation / Automation Quality Assurance
Programming: Python/Java, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Clean Code, Reusable Test Components
UI Automation: Selenium, Playwright, Web Application Testing
API Testing: REST APIs, Service Testing, Request and Response Validation, Integration Testing, Negative Testing
Database Testing: SQL, Relational Databases, Data Validation, Data Integrity, Data Transformation Testing
Version Control: Git, Branching, Pull Requests, Code Reviews
Testing Practices: Software Testing Methodologies, Test Design, Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Integration Testing, Exploratory Testing, Risk-Based Testing, Defect Management
Development Lifecycle: SDLC, STLC, Requirements Analysis, Release Validation
AI-Assisted Testing: AI Tools, Test-Case Generation, Test-Data Generation, Automation Code Assistance, Failure Analysis, Responsible AI Usage
Troubleshooting: Root-Cause Analysis, Log Analysis, Technical Problem Solving, Defect Investigation
Senior-Level Ownership: Independent Delivery, Quality Ownership, Test Strategy, Automation Code Reviews, Risk Identification, Stakeholder Management, Continuous Improvement
Planning and Organisation: Prioritisation, Time Management, Delivery Planning, Managing Multiple Activities
Communication: Clear Verbal Communication, Clear Written Communication, Proactive Communication, Quality Reporting, Risk Escalation
Collaboration: Multicultural Environment, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Distributed Teams, Knowledge Sharing
Professional Approach: Accountability, Attention to Detail, Proactivity, Critical Thinking, Quality Focus
 Nice-to-Have Skills
BDD: Behaviour-Driven Development, Cucumber, Behave, SpecFlow, Gherkin
DevOps: DevOps Concepts, CI/CD, Automated Quality Gates, Pipeline Integration, Docker, Containerisation
Certification: ISTQB Foundation Level, ISTQB Advanced Level, Test Automation Certification
Automation Strategy: Test Automation Planning, Framework Design, Framework Architecture, Framework Evaluation, Automation Roadmaps, Test Maintainability, Test Scalability
Agile: Agile Methodologies, Scrum, Kanban, Sprint Planning, Refinement, Retrospectives
Data Testing: Data Pipelines, ETL Testing, Large Dataset Validation, Scheduled Processing, Numerical Calculation Testing
Domain Knowledge: Financial Services, Capital Markets, Quantitative Analytics, Market Data
Quality Engineering: Test Reporting, Quality Metrics, Observability, Continuous Testing, Performance Testing
